title: Bonk
blurb: A sharp cartoon thwack, most famously wielded by a Shiba Inu with a baseball bat and a strong sense of civic duty. The bonk meme built an entire justice system out of one sound effect: a cursed thought is expressed, the bat descends, and the offender is dispatched to horny jail without trial or appeal. No discussion is entered into. That efficiency is why it survived long after the original image stopped circulating — the sound alone now carries the full legal proceedings. One bonk, no consultation, straight to jail.
origin: The corrective cartoon bonk of the Cheems bat meme.
